game.title: Aquagentic
game.tagline: Ultralight AI Agent Client & Gamified Aquarium Fishing

clownfish.name: Clownfish
clownfish.desc: A vibrant reef fish (Amphiprion ocellaris) living in protective symbiosis with sea anemones.

blue_tang.name: Blue Tang
blue_tang.desc: A brilliant sapphire blue fish with a vibrant yellow tail fin (Paracanthurus hepatus) grazing across coral heads.

seahorse.name: Crowned Seahorse
seahorse.desc: An elegant upright fish (Hippocampus coronatus) anchoring itself to sea grasses with its prehensile tail.

french_angelfish.name: French Angelfish
french_angelfish.desc: A majestic Caribbean reef grazer adorned with velvety black scales bordered in shimmering gold (Pomacanthus paru).

lionfish.name: Red Lionfish
lionfish.desc: A striking predatory marvel boasting venomous rayed spines and tiger-striped bands (Pterois volitans).

mandarin_dragonet.name: Mandarin Dragonet
mandarin_dragonet.desc: One of the most visually stunning marine creatures, patterned in psychedelic turquoise and orange mazes (Synchiropus splendidus).

copperband_butterfly.name: Copperband Butterflyfish
copperband_butterfly.desc: An ornate butterflyfish with gleaming copper bands and an elongated snout built for crevice foraging (Chelmon rostratus).

pufferfish.name: Dwarf Pufferfish
pufferfish.desc: A curious fish that inflates itself with water into a spiny sphere when threatened by predators.

blue_ringed_octopus.name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
blue_ringed_octopus.desc: A small cephalopod displaying glowing iridescent blue rings when agitated (Hapalochlaena lunulata).

anglerfish.name: Deep Sea Anglerfish
anglerfish.desc: A creature of the midnight zone armed with a bioluminescent dorsal photophore lure (Melanocetus johnsonii).

moray_eel.name: Giant Moray Eel
moray_eel.desc: A muscular serpentine predator with a pharyngeal second jaw lurking inside rocky crevices (Gymnothorax javanicus).

barracuda.name: Great Barracuda
barracuda.desc: A lightning-fast torpedo predator equipped with razor-sharp dagger teeth (Sphyraena barracuda).

goblin_shark.name: Goblin Shark
goblin_shark.desc: A living prehistoric relic of the abyss with jaws that slingshot forward to ambush prey (Mitsukurina owstoni).

black_dragonfish.name: Black Dragonfish
black_dragonfish.desc: An abyssal deep-sea terror possessing light-trapping black skin and transparent needle fangs.

hammerhead_shark.name: Great Hammerhead Shark
hammerhead_shark.desc: A formidable ocean predator with a wide cephalofoil head packed with electromagnetic ampullae (Sphyrna mokarran).

manta_ray.name: Giant Oceanic Manta Ray
manta_ray.desc: A gentle pelagic wanderer with wings stretching over seven meters flying gracefully through open sea currents (Mobula birostris).

ocean_sunfish.name: Giant Ocean Sunfish
ocean_sunfish.desc: The world's heaviest bony fish, characterized by a rounded body and a calm, majestic presence (Mola mola).

great_white_shark.name: Great White Shark
great_white_shark.desc: The apex predator of coastal waters, representing millions of years of predatory perfection (Carcharodon carcharias).

whale_shark.name: Whale Shark
whale_shark.desc: The largest fish on Earth (Rhincodon typus), a colossal gentle giant dotted with star-like constellations.

giant_oarfish.name: Giant Oarfish
giant_oarfish.desc: A mythical, ribbon-like silver sea serpent reaching up to 11 meters with an ethereal crimson crest (Regalecus glesne).

coelacanth.name: Prehistoric Coelacanth
coelacanth.desc: A 400-million-year-old living fossil with lobed fins, long believed extinct with the dinosaurs (Latimeria chalumnae).

colossal_squid.name: Colossal Squid
colossal_squid.desc: The most massive invertebrate on Earth, prowling the freezing Antarctic deep armed with rotating tentacle hooks.

greenland_shark.name: Greenland Shark
greenland_shark.desc: The longest-living vertebrate known, silently roaming Arctic ocean depths for more than four centuries (Somniosus microcephalus).

neuro_surge.name: Ring Pulse
neuro_surge.desc: Fills 25% of the bait bar with each successful tool action.

abyssal_lure.name: Bioluminescent Lure
abyssal_lure.desc: Doubles pearl generation during deep thinking sessions.

electro_detection.name: Electro-Sense
electro_detection.desc: Detects and consumes common duplicates to forge Coral Fragments.

angler.name: Reef Angler
angler.title: Fishing Quests
angler.subtitle: Complete my catch bounties to earn pirate chests and pearls!

quest.clownfish: Hey you! Go catch a Clownfish from the reef right now. Not for eating, I just like their cheeky attitude among the anemones!
quest.blue_tang: I need a Blue Tang for my tank! Just make sure it doesn't forget how to swim straight.
quest.seahorse: I saw a Seahorse gliding through the seaweed! Go hook it before it coils its tail and hides away.
quest.french_angelfish: The French Angelfish has fancy gold-rimmed scales. Catch one for my luxury collection!
quest.lionfish: Watch the venomous spines! The Lionfish is an invasive menace. Pull it out of the water immediately!
quest.mandarin_dragonet: That Mandarin Dragonet has dazzling psychedelic patterns! Bring it to me in one piece.
quest.copperband_butterfly: The Copperband Butterflyfish feeds deep in the coral crevices. Put your tokens to the test and reel it in.
quest.pufferfish: I want to see a Pufferfish puff up like a spiky ball! Bring me a real chubby one.
quest.blue_ringed_octopus: Extreme biohazard warning! The Blue-Ringed Octopus is lethal. Reel it in with extreme caution!
quest.anglerfish: That Deep Sea Anglerfish has its own glowing headlamp! Imagine the edge it would give me fishing at night.
quest.moray_eel: A Giant Moray Eel tried to bite my rod in half! Go down there and reel it in to teach it a lesson.
quest.hammerhead_shark: The Great Hammerhead is on the prowl! Show me you've got real angler grit and catch it.
quest.manta_ray: The great Manta Ray glides through the deep like an ocean bird! Bring one in for my lagoon.
quest.sailfish: The Sailfish is the fastest swimmer in the sea! Cast your rod with all your might and catch it.
quest.whale_shark: The largest fish on the entire planet! The Whale Shark is the ultimate trophy. Go catch it!
quest.coelacanth: A LIVING FOSSIL! The Coelacanth has survived for 400 million years. Bring it to me and I'll reward you like a king!

rod_efficiency.name: Rod Carbon Tuning
rod_efficiency.desc: Drastically reduces token cast cost for fishing chests (from 500 tk down to 120 tk).

algae.name: Bioluminescent Algae
algae.desc: Fertilizes the ecosystem, boosting all tank fish PPS by +15% per level.

tank.name: Aquarium Tank Expansion
tank.desc: Expands background tank swimming fish capacity (+2 fish slots per level).

chum.name: Deep-Sea Chum Barrel
chum.desc: Attracts rare, epic, and mythic marine species with greater frequency.

magnet.name: Agentic Pearl Magnet
magnet.desc: Harvests bonus pearls directly with every prompt processed or code execution.
